note: Colloquial; 美元 is the standard written term.

examples.zh: 请问，一美金能换多少人民币？
examples.en: Excuse me, how many yuan does one US dollar buy?

examples.zh: 我带了五百美金去旅游。
examples.en: I took 500 US dollars on the trip.

examples.zh: 你可以用美金付钱吗？
examples.en: Can you pay in US dollars?

meaning: noisy; to make noise, to cause a fuss; to have (a stomach problem)

senses.en: noisy; to make noise, to cause a fuss; to have (a stomach problem)

note: 闹肚子 means to have diarrhea; 闹 also means to make a scene.

examples.zh: 楼上太闹了，我睡不着。
examples.en: It's so noisy upstairs that I can't sleep.

examples.zh: 别在教室里闹了，老师来了。
examples.en: Stop messing around in the classroom; the teacher is coming.

examples.zh: 他吃坏了东西，闹肚子了。
examples.en: He ate something bad and has an upset stomach.

note: Often about the mind: 头脑清醒; also 醒过来 for waking up.

examples.zh: 他喝了咖啡，才清醒了一点儿。
examples.en: He only felt more awake after drinking coffee.

examples.zh: 做重要的决定时，头脑要清醒。
examples.en: Keep a clear head when making important decisions.

examples.zh: 病人已经清醒了，你们可以进去看他。
examples.en: The patient has come to; you can go in to see him.

meaning: to touch, to feel with the hand

senses.en: to touch, to feel with the hand

note: 摸一下 / 摸摸 for a light touch; 别摸 is a common warning.

examples.zh: 别摸我的头发！
examples.en: Don't touch my hair!

examples.zh: 医生摸了摸我的肚子。
examples.en: The doctor felt my belly.

examples.zh: 你摸一下他的头，是不是发烧了？
examples.en: Feel his forehead; does he have a fever?

meaning: to think carefully about, to reflect on

senses.en: to think carefully about, to reflect on

note: More serious than 想; takes a problem as object: 思考问题.

examples.zh: 这个问题我需要思考一下。
examples.en: I need to think this question over.

examples.zh: 他喜欢一个人安静地思考。
examples.en: He likes to think quietly on his own.

examples.zh: 遇到问题，要多思考。
examples.en: When you meet a problem, think it through.

note: Formal, for notices and devices: 关闭手机, 暂时关闭. Casual speech uses 关.

examples.zh: 因为下雨，公园今天关闭。
examples.en: The park is closed today because of the rain.

examples.zh: 起飞前请关闭手机。
examples.en: Please turn off your phone before takeoff.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆生意不好，已经关闭了。
examples.en: This restaurant did poorly and has shut down.

note: Written and medical register; in daily talk people say 药.

examples.zh: 医生说这种药物可能会让人想睡觉。
examples.en: The doctor said this medicine may make you sleepy.

examples.zh: 你现在吃什么药物？
examples.en: Which medicines are you taking now?

examples.zh: 这些药物要放在孩子拿不到的地方。
examples.en: Keep these medicines where children can't reach them.

note: 合作伙伴 is a business partner; 好伙伴 a good buddy.

examples.zh: 他是我最好的工作伙伴。
examples.en: He is my best work partner.

examples.zh: 我们想找一个合作伙伴。
examples.en: We want to find a business partner.

examples.zh: 旅行的时候，有个好伙伴很重要。
examples.en: When traveling, a good companion matters.

note: Opens the last sentence to sum up, usually followed by a comma.

examples.zh: 总之，这件事不能怪你。
examples.en: In short, you can't be blamed for this.

examples.zh: 价格、位置、服务都不错，总之，我很满意。
examples.en: Price, location, and service are all fine; in short, I'm satisfied.

examples.zh: 他说了很多，总之就是不想去。
examples.en: He said a lot, but in the end he just doesn't want to go.

meaning: measure word for boxes, cases, crates

senses.en: measure word for boxes, cases, crates

note: Counts boxed goods: 一箱牛奶, 两箱书.

examples.zh: 我买了两箱牛奶。
examples.en: I bought two cases of milk.

examples.zh: 他搬了三箱书到新家。
examples.en: He carried three boxes of books to his new home.

examples.zh: 这箱苹果多少钱？
examples.en: How much is this box of apples?

meaning: to run into, to meet (by chance)

senses.en: to run into, to meet (by chance)

note: Unplanned meeting; for planned ones use 见面.

examples.zh: 我在路上遇见了一位老朋友。
examples.en: I ran into an old friend on the street.

examples.zh: 昨天我在超市遇见老师了。
examples.en: Yesterday I met my teacher at the supermarket.

examples.zh: 你是在哪儿遇见他的？
examples.en: Where did you meet him?

note: Formal; 医疗机构, 研究机构, 政府机构.

examples.zh: 他在一家研究机构工作。
examples.en: He works at a research institution.

examples.zh: 这个机构帮助生病的儿童。
examples.en: This organization helps sick children.

examples.zh: 你可以去医疗机构做检查。
examples.en: You can get checked at a medical institution.

note: Formal, for the near future: 即将开始, 即将到来.

examples.zh: 火车即将到达北京站。
examples.en: The train is about to arrive at Beijing station.

examples.zh: 比赛即将开始，大家请坐好。
examples.en: The match is about to start; please take your seats.

examples.zh: 我的假期即将结束。
examples.en: My vacation is about to end.

meaning: plate; measure word for dishes served on a plate

senses.en: plate; measure word for dishes served on a plate

note: 一盘菜 / 一盘饺子; the thing itself is 盘子.

examples.zh: 我们再点一盘饺子吧。
examples.en: Let's order another plate of dumplings.

examples.zh: 桌子上有一盘水果。
examples.en: There is a plate of fruit on the table.

examples.zh: 这盘菜太咸了。
examples.en: This dish is too salty.

note: Pair: 受得了 (can bear). Often follows 真 or 简直.

examples.zh: 天气太热，我受不了了。
examples.en: The weather is so hot I can't stand it.

examples.zh: 他说话太大声，我受不了。
examples.en: He talks too loudly; I can't take it.

examples.zh: 这种味道我真受不了。
examples.en: I really can't stand this smell.

meaning: to lie in, to rest with; to depend on

senses.en: to lie in, to rest with; to depend on

note: Formal; 关键在于... "the key lies in...". Not used for physical location.

examples.zh: 成功在于努力。
examples.en: Success comes down to hard work.

examples.zh: 问题在于我们没有足够的时间。
examples.en: The problem is that we don't have enough time.

examples.zh: 去不去，在于你自己。
examples.en: Whether to go is up to you.

meaning: lesson learned from experience; to scold

senses.en: lesson learned from experience; to scold

note: 吸取教训 (learn the lesson); as a verb, 教训 someone is to give a talking-to.

examples.zh: 这次的教训我会记住的。
examples.en: I'll remember the lesson from this time.

examples.zh: 他迟到了，被老板教训了一顿。
examples.en: He was late and got a scolding from the boss.

examples.zh: 我们要从失败中得到教训。
examples.en: We must learn lessons from failure.

note: Technical word; for everyday items people say 设备 or 机器.

examples.zh: 这套装置是工人昨天安装的。
examples.en: Workers installed this equipment yesterday.

examples.zh: 这个装置能把水变干净。
examples.en: This device can make water clean.

examples.zh: 工厂里有一个新装置。
examples.en: There is a new piece of equipment in the factory.

note: Food: 新鲜蔬菜, 新鲜空气; also "novel": 新鲜事.

examples.zh: 这些菜很新鲜，是早上买的。
examples.en: These vegetables are fresh; I bought them this morning.

examples.zh: 我想出去呼吸一下新鲜空气。
examples.en: I want to go out for some fresh air.

examples.zh: 对我来说，这里的一切都很新鲜。
examples.en: For me, everything here is new and interesting.

note: Applies to work, prices, networks, moods and conditions.

examples.zh: 他的工作很稳定，每月收入差不多。
examples.en: His job is stable, and his monthly income is about the same.

examples.zh: 病人的情况已经稳定了。
examples.en: The patient's condition has stabilized.

examples.zh: 这里的网络不太稳定。
examples.en: The network here is not very stable.
